🚀 obs-lite | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: A simple, efficient, and user-friendly screen recording solution for Windows users, particularly those familiar with OBS Studio, who need a portable tool for capturing video and audio without extensive setup.
✨ Key Features: • Lightweight and portable (~7 MB .exe) • OBS Studio-like interface • Hardware H.264 encoding to MP4 • Desktop audio and microphone recording • Pause recording functionality
📖 Summary: obs-lite is a lightweight, portable screen recording application for Windows, designed with a familiar OBS Studio-like interface. It focuses on efficient hardware H.264 encoding to MP4, capturing desktop audio and microphone input, and offers features like pause functionality and global hotkeys, all within a single executable file.
